newsitem.title: USA: Owens-Illinois sets terms of debenture offer.
newsitem.headline: Owens-Illinois sets terms of debenture offer.

text.p: Owens-Illinois Inc said on Wednesday that it had set a consideration of $1,115.60 for each $1,000 principal amount of its 11 percent senior debentures.

The price, which includes a $20.00 consent payment, refers to the company's previously announced offer to purchase its outstanding 11 percent senior debentures due 2003 and applies to debentures tendered before 5 p.m., New York City time, on May 9.
The tender offer is currently scheduled to expire at midnight, New York City time, on May 22, the company said.
Owens-Illinois is a manufacturer of packaging products.
